findings.title: Home misreports a connected signed physical reader as unavailable
evidence: apps/mobile/src/core/devicePresentation.ts:107-168 has no connected_reader branch; falls through at161 to unavailable
apps/mobile/src/ui/device-summary.tsx:29-47 uses this presentation and only a Synthetic only connected badge
findings.reproduction: Complete an admitted signed-reader handshake, retaining connected_reader and a verified binding. Render Home with that actual snapshot. presentDevice falls through to Reader connection unavailable; the summary also blanket-declares qualified channels unavailable. Device detail may correctly show signed protocol, so the contradiction is in Home.
findings.impact: Person receives false recovery instructions and cannot distinguish connection from independently admitted channel availability.
findings.required_correction: Represent current physical connection/binding and actual capability separately; retain unqualified/unapproved reasons without calling real evidence synthetic or inventing participant approval.
findings.verification: Actual Home component assertion for unbound connected_reader, verified current binding, permitted/denied channel, disconnect/reboot, plus synthetic connection. No physical qualification follows.

findings.classification: demonstrated source-path lifecycle defect; no new mounted execution
findings.title: An HR result arriving in an already open result screen cannot acquire display admission
evidence: apps/mobile/src/ui/checks.tsx:1682-1696 effect returns for pending/measurement result; dependencies only check.id/epoch
apps/mobile/src/services/sync.ts:657-668 later updates same owned check with verified HR result
apps/mobile/src/controller.ts:5291-5302 polls awaiting_result without route identity change
apps/mobile/src/controller.ts:4029-4071 manual refresh re-admits only an already existing hrResultView
findings.reproduction: Keep ResultScreen mounted for a locally saved measurement or awaiting-result check. Deliver its valid HR1.1 result through existing sync polling with unchanged check ID/epoch. Leaving/reopening is a workaround.
findings.impact: Normal async completion stalls the legitimate research result journey. The new guard fails closed; this is availability/usability, not evidence of numeric disclosure.
findings.required_correction: Make active-view admission react to exact result identity/HR arrival and scope changes while preserving refusal, token disposal, immutable results and late-callback fences.
findings.verification: Mount actual production ResultScreen pending/measurement, deliver a valid same-ID HR result, assert fresh exact admission GET and current numeric display; include refusal/mismatch/offline/late-response negatives and repeated updates without loops.

findings.title: Successful OAuth response does not validate its actual returned callback URL
evidence: apps/mobile/src/services/auth.ts:94-125 prompt result checks type/state/code/verifier but not result.url
apps/mobile/tests/auth-acceptance.test.ts:14-78 checks successful callback replay, not substituted return target
findings.reproduction: Return a success-shaped AuthSession response with matching pending state/code but a different result.url. The production sign-in path reaches consume/exchange without admitting the returned URL. Prevalidated requested redirect and metadata do not validate this return value.
findings.impact: The account-entry implementation omits an explicit required integrity check before code exchange; actual provider/platform exploitability is not established by this source inspection.
findings.required_correction: Validate returned URL against exact pending callback identity and reconcile callback query fields before consuming/exchanging. Preserve PKCE/state, platform callbacks, environment pinning and no secret logging.
findings.verification: Actual AuthManager success response with substituted scheme/host/path or inconsistent query must reject before exchange; valid native/web callback and successful single-use replay controls remain positive.
